label: News
title: Higgsfield Global Film Festival announces its 2026 winners
excerpt: Higgsfield handed out its $1,000,000 prize pool: "Listen to Meh" takes the $500,000 top prize, with Fukushima and The Field Agent placing second and third, and ten more films earning Honorable Mentions.
body: Higgsfield has announced the results of its 2026 Global Film Festival, a competition that invited filmmakers around the world to make original short films using the platform's generative AI tools. Fourteen films in total were awarded out of a $1,000,000 prize pool, split across three jury-ranked prizes, an Audience Choice Award, and ten Honorable Mentions.

The $500,000 first prize went to "Listen to Meh", by creator @rococo_table_radical. Second place and $200,000 went to "Fukushima" (@aist), and third place with $100,000 went to "The Field Agent" (@zackmmurray). The Audience Choice Award — also carrying a $100,000 prize — went to "The Tortoise and the Hare" (@benhamin), a fable about a group of adventurous rabbits hunting for a legendary golden tortoise.

Ten further films received Honorable Mentions worth $10,000 each: BALLAST (@lejardinier), FIX (@production_pi_korea), ROAR (@vermeer_ice_9000), Soulless (@yoav_yariv), THE COAT (@davidacfilm), Morek (@zezumre), Lullaby (@keigo_matsumaru), GIRLS / DEMONS (@tambv), The Elevator (@curious_media_2026), and HUNGER (@sssacccade).
The full results, with posters and director credits for every winning film, are up on AIMB's Higgsfield Global Film Festival page.
